meta.name: tech-debt-audit
meta.description: Thorough, file-cited technical debt audit across 9 dimensions using AST-grep (tree-sitter), grep, LSP, and language-native tooling. Produces TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md with severity, effort estimates, and prioritized fixes. Use when asked for codebase health check, tech debt audit, architecture review, code quality assessment, or cleanup planning. Triggers: 'tech debt', 'technical debt', 'debt audit', 'code health', 'technical debt audit', 'codebase health check', 'find tech debt', 'debt analysis', 'audit code quality'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审计代码库九大维度,输出带优先级的技术债报告。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想动手重构前先摸清代码库里哪些地方最该修。
copy.tagline_en: Audit code on 9 dimensions and get a prioritized tech-debt report.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to know what to fix before refactoring.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按 9 个维度扫描代码库,逐条列出技术债并标注严重程度与工时估计,最后在仓库根目录写出 TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md,每条发现都带 file:line 引用。
howto.when: 当你提到 “tech debt” 等关键词,或要求做代码库健康检查、架构评审、清理规划时触发。

say.text: 对整个仓库跑一次技术债审计,结果写进 TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md
say.note: 会在仓库根目录生成报告文件

say.text: 重点查安全与错误处理这两个维度的技术债

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude scans your codebase across 9 dimensions, lists each debt item with severity and effort estimates, and writes TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md to the repo root with file:line citations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention “tech debt” and similar keywords, or ask for a codebase health check, architecture review, or cleanup planning.

say_en.text: Run a full tech debt audit on the whole repo into TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md
say_en.note: Creates the report file in the repo root

say_en.text: Focus only on the security and error-handling dimensions
say_en.note: Reports findings only for those two dimensions

say_en.text: Rank the top 5 fix priorities by impact vs effort
